description: Issue #400: the canned primary response's external_rationale_for_footnote verbatim-quotes a hard_rejections[].description string -- confidential internal-strategy reasoning that must never reach a counterparty. review_spine.run_review's own leakage gate (scripts/leakage_scan.py) must block this to ERROR_MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED before any redline is generated.

clauses.heading: 10. Indemnification
clauses.text: The Company shall indemnify Institution for any and all claims, without limit.

issues.counterparty_change_summary: Counterparty introduced one-way indemnification of Institution by the Company.
issues.external_rationale_for_footnote: Counterparty introduces general or one-way indemnification by the Company. Narrow mutual IP or gross-negligence/willful-misconduct indemnification capped by Section 8 is an acceptable variation (see indemnification topic) and must not fire this rule. Trigger 'company\s+(shall|will|must|agrees?\s+to)\b[^.]{0,40}indemnif' (regex, in regex_trigger_terms) catches one-way the Company indemnification across common modal/volitional phrasings without firing on mutual or each-party formulations. Issue #220: this regex trigger lives in regex_trigger_terms, not trigger_terms, so the plain phrases 'hold harmless' and 'duty to defend' are matched as word-boundary phrases, not compiled as regex.
issues.proposed_replacement_text: Neither party shall bear responsibility for defending or compensating the other party for third-party claims arising under this Agreement, except as expressly and narrowly set forth in Section 8.
issues.source_quote: The Company shall indemnify Institution for any and all claims, without limit.

primary.verdict_summary: One issue identified requiring attention before your organization can accept this draft.
